title: Transfection of Constructs in Diplonemids to Enhance the HR Pathway Using RS-1
author: Binnypreet Kaur
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x45fqy6

steps.title: Prepare Cells
steps.instruction: Count the cells and plan for one nucleofection using 5x10^7 cells per construct.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells via centrifugation at 1300xg for 5 minutes at room temperature using a Swing Bucket Rotor.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100µl of AMAXA Human T-cell solution at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Combine 81.8µl of Human T-cell nucleofector solution with 18.2µl Supplement from the refrigerator.

steps.title: Prepare DNA and Enhancer
steps.instruction: Prepare 5-10µg of linearized PCR DNA and 0.3µM RS-1 enhancer by resuspending them in 10µl of H2O.

steps.title: Load Electroporator
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell and DNA mixture into the cuvette, close the cap, and place it in the electroporator.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the cuvette is inserted in the correct direction with the metal sides facing towards you.

steps.title: Perform Electroporation
steps.instruction: Run Program X-001 to electroporate and follow the remaining steps as specified in the transformation protocol.
